statement.p: Let T be an linear transformation from {\mathbb R}^r to {\mathbb R}^s. Let A be the matrix associated to T.
Fill in the correct answer for each of the following situations.

li.p: Two columns in the row-echelon form of A are not pivot columns.
The row-echelon form of A has no column corresponding to a free variable.
Every column in the row-echelon form of A is a pivot column.
The row-echelon form of A has a column corresponding to a free variable.
There is not enough information to tell.
